entries.reason: HealthKit arrived in iOS 8.0 and this release, iOS 6.1.3, has none of it: the armv7 shared cache of 6.1.3 and the one of 4.3 hold no HealthKit image and neither exports a name of it (measured: no string of either cache is HealthKit, with NSObject and PassKit as the controls that say the probe finds what is there). The store is this port's own SQLite database, not Apple's, so the class is carried whole. a day's standing in the three rings of the activity ring, with each ring's total and its goal
entries.effect: the six quantities are kept as they are set and read back as they were set, and each begins at zero in the unit the header names for its ring - kilocalories for the move ring, minutes for the exercise ring and hours for the stand ring - so a ring the phone has not counted yet reads as a number and not a nil. dateComponentsForCalendar: converts the day into the caller's own calendar, so one day asked for through two calendars gives the two calendars' days of it. NSSecureCoding and NSCopying carry the day and all six quantities
